dispel.title: Buff removal
dispel.formula: Chance per buff = base + 2 × (skill level − buff level) + buff duration in seconds ÷ 120
dispel.noteRange: The result always stays within {{min}}–{{max}}% and is rolled separately for each buff. M.Atk, M.Def and shots do not matter.
dispel.noteSource: The base and magic levels are server data of this chronicle. The formula and limits are documented for Gracia–Freya; other chronicles may have differed.

landing.title: What the land chance depends on
landing.levelDiffNote: the skill's level counts ({{magicLevel}}), not the character's; no penalty for targets up to level {{free}}, no bonus for lower ones
landing.levelDiffNone: this skill does not depend on the target's level
landing.generalResNote: resistances can also shorten the duration
landing.skillLevelNote: helps only against targets above level {{free}}
landing.skillLevelNone: this skill does not depend on level
landing.attributeNote: weapon and skill attribute minus the target's defense; only when the weapon has the same attribute
landing.notePp: pp means percentage points for the values entered above, counted before the limit.
landing.noteStartMagic: The default M.Atk and M.Def are examples: with a Blessed Spiritshot they give a ×1 multiplier.
landing.noteIgnoredMagic: Soulshots, P.Atk and the attacker's WIT are not part of the formula, and the character's level counts only through M.Atk. Enter M.Atk from the status window: “Extra INT” and “Extra M.Atk” are added on top of it.
landing.noteIgnoredPhysical: Physical skill: M.Atk, M.Def, spiritshots, soulshots and P.Atk do not change the debuff chance.
landing.noteData: {{stat}}, base {{rate}}%, level modifier {{bonus}} and magic level {{magicLevel}} are server data of this chronicle.
landing.noteDataTrait: {{stat}}, base {{rate}}%, level modifier {{bonus}}, type “{{trait}}” and magic level {{magicLevel}} are server data of this chronicle.
landing.noteFormulaKnown: The formula itself is <source>documented for Gracia–High Five</source>.
landing.noteFormulaUnknown: The formula itself is <source>documented for Gracia–High Five</source>; there is no public confirmation for {{chronicle}}, so the percentages are approximate.
landing.intText: Total INT counts (base, dyes, set and buffs together), with no threshold. The server takes a multiplier from the INT bonus table that grows by about 2% per point. M.Atk is multiplied by its square and sits under the square root in the formula, so the chance grows exactly as the multiplier does. The neutral point lies between 31 and 32 INT: below it the multiplier is a penalty, above it a bonus. At {{int}} INT it is ×{{bonus}}. INT from dyes works the same as base INT; the multiplier is rounded to 1%, so consecutive points give slightly different gains.
